title: Explain sandbox 'Access is denied' on control pipe; add sandbox note to Codex skills
body:
Symptom: from a Codex agent, every foreman CLI verb fails with "foreman <verb>: cannot reach foreman (Access is denied. (os error 5)) — is it running?" even though foreman is running. Repro: `codex sandbox -- $env:FOREMAN_EXE status` (fails) vs `& $env:FOREMAN_EXE status` (works).

Cause: ~/.codex/config.toml has `[windows] sandbox = "unelevated"`, so Codex runs commands under a restricted token. The control pipe (FOREMAN_PIPE / \\.\pipe\foreman) uses the default DACL, and the restricted token's CreateFileW gets ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (interprocess 2.4.2 connect_without_waiting only special-cases ERROR_PIPE_BUSY). Not a race: 40 concurrent unsandboxed calls all pass.

1) Error message: src/control.rs `report()` sends every non-TimedOut Err to "cannot reach foreman ... is it running?". Add an arm for `e.kind() == ErrorKind::PermissionDenied` saying foreman is running but this process can't open its control pipe (sandboxed, e.g. Codex) — run outside the sandbox / with escalated approval. Note `kanban wait` has its own copy of the unreachable message (search "foreman kanban wait: cannot reach foreman") — cover it too. TDD: extract the message choice into a pure fn keyed on ErrorKind and test the branch selection, not the literal text.

2) Codex skills: .codex/skills/foreman-kanban/SKILL.md already has a "Sandbox note" (escalate foreman commands up front). Add the same note to the other Codex skills that hit the pipe (foreman-dispatch, foreman-chat, and any others calling FOREMAN_EXE — icat is client-side, no pipe). These are embedded via include_str! in src/skills_install.rs and installed on launch; edit the repo copies under .codex/skills/. See foreman-change-control skill for the skill-copy editing rules.

Out of scope: loosening the pipe DACL to admit restricted tokens — that widens a same-user command-execution surface (security posture decision, foreman-change-control).
